about: Walter Decision — needs declared by the modules that ask typed decisions (llm/decision.py). A caller names its need in the request (walter_memory.llm.decide sends its processor). Policy only: the Router's decision chain chooses and orders the models. memo_ttl_s = window in which the same state + questions + chain reuse the answer already given (0 = never); escalate_below = confidence under which a question is asked again to the next model of the chain (null = off until a bench sets it); max_timeout_s = cap on the caller's timeout per call (null = the caller's). types = the question kinds the need asks today (noul, choice, score, multiple = choice of several options, text, number, date, estimate = number with a range, spans, box, boxes); new_kinds = kinds that fit its purpose and that a route can carry since 17/11, with where (not asked yet: the owning module adopts them). Each kind is checked against the decision chain by `walter-router decision-needs` (llm/decision.py capabilities: native, Extractions route, emulated, or refused).

walter-context-preflight.purpose: plan of each owner message: thread, act, context level, tier, modules

new_kinds.multiple: since 17/11 (2.0) the modules a message needs (Context's `needs` signal) are one multiple, emulated as one noul per option on every route (OpenRouter included); native only on Liquid's own API (not wired: no key)
new_kinds.spans: since 17/11 the days (resolved by Walter) and the people the message names, asked apart from the judgements so the plan never waits for them; only d1.2 / d1.2-ultra carry them (OpenRouter Extractions)

triage.purpose: incoming event: ignore / remember / notify / prepare a reply

new_kinds.number: since 17/11 (2.0): the amount of the last incoming message (EUR), read by Walter when the model finds it without its value
new_kinds.date: since 17/11: the deadline, read by Walter against the message's day (order dmy)
new_kinds.text: the person to answer (not asked yet)

views.purpose: organic memory views: subject / episode / period assignment

disclosure.commitment.purpose: does an outgoing message commit the owner

new_kinds.spans: since 17/11 (2.0): the days an outgoing message commits to (resolved by Walter); every piece of personal data (17/11: 13/13 found on Walter cases) not asked yet
new_kinds.number: since 17/11: the amount it commits to

documents.verify.purpose: check a fact drawn from a document against it

new_kinds.text: the value a fact claims, read from the document with its span

sourced-observation/1.verify.purpose: check an observation against its source

context-intent-bench.purpose: bench of the intent questions (never reused: each sample counts)
